An '''iron hoe''' is a [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from two [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Farming and mining ===
It breaks hoe blocks at speed 8, two faster than the [[copper hoe]], and has 500 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 3.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart. With a [[smithing upgrade template]] it becomes a [[steel mattock]].
